bio: Housed within a beautiful Georgian townhouse on Seymour Street in Marylebone, The Zetter Townhouse enjoys an enviable location only moments from Oxford Street and Hyde Park.  While the sister Townhouse in Clerkenwell is known as the home of Zetter's Great Aunt Wilhelmina, the Marylebone property is that of their Wicked Uncle Seymour.  Afternoon Tea is served in the quirky Seymour's Parlour which has been designed by Russell Sage. The Parlour was inspired by Sir John Soane's architectural collection with red toned walls, mismatched antique furniture, and walls adorned with frames and ornaments.  You can choose between two Afternoon Tea menus. The Aunt Wilhelmina menu which features the classic sandwich selection, an assortment of cakes and pastries, and of course, freshly baked scones. Uncle Seymour's Afternoon Tea includes a mouth-watering savoury selection accompanied by cakes, pastries and scones.
